claims.source_fact: Positive weighted sums of observable-expectation products form PSD kernels, including global and projected cases.
claims.transfer_limit: PSD is a Gram property and does not require each pairwise entry to be nonnegative. It is not enough for native attention mass.

claims.source_fact: ExactH shells contain precisely H-body Pauli terms, while S-subsystem overlaps include lower-body terms and an identity component.
claims.transfer_limit: Raw exactH replacement may be signed; positive S completion changes offset/relative weights and is a separate model. No automatic native-EPS invariance.

claims.source_fact: Distribution-dependent covariance eigenoperators diagonalize the global kernel; weighting those operators rescales its eigenvalues.
claims.transfer_limit: An arbitrary operator-space orthogonal basis transformation is not automatically one physical Hilbert-space basis conjugation.

claims.source_fact: Mercer-local construction invokes one U0 mapping the Mercer operators into normalized Pauli operators.
